description: This file is a shell script containing tests and setup procedures for verifying repository pruning behavior in Git, especially in scenarios involving corrupt or bogus references and objects.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specified description and commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to be executed after a test case completes, typically for cleanup.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; if it succeeds, the test fails.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
